text: 中国9月社融新增3.55万亿元，人民币贷款新增1.08万亿，环比双双大幅回升。 上观：中国极紫外光源样机国产化率达90%，目前距离量产还需3—5年。 通胀全面走热！美国9月CPI同比增长3.7%，核心CPI同比增长2.6%超预期，10月加息预期飙升。 特朗普称格陵兰岛将开始”大规模”石油、天然气和矿产勘探。 美联储理事鲍曼：不认为美联储有必要进一步加息。 中欧就混动、电动汽车贸易达成磋商共识，中汽协发布声明。 日本银行保险五个月净买5.4万亿日元日债，资金回流信号升温。 IEA月报：柴油供应紧张局面将持续至2027年，OECD石油库存降至1989年以来最
text_en: China's September aggregate social financing increased by 3.55 trillion yuan, and RMB loans increased by 1.08 trillion, both rebounding sharply month-on-month. Shangguan: China's extreme ultraviolet light source prototype has reached a 90% domestic content rate, and it is still 3-5 years away from mass production. Inflation is heating up across the board! US September CPI rose 3.7% year-on-year, while core CPI rose 2.6% year-on-year, exceeding expectations, and October rate hike expectations surged. Trump said Greenland will begin "large-scale" oil, natural gas and mineral exploration. Federal Reserve Governor Bowman: does not believe the Fed needs to raise rates further. China and Europe reached a consensus in consultations on hybrid and electric vehicle trade, and the China Association of Automobile Manufacturers issued a statement. Japanese banks and insurers net bought 5.4 trillion yen of Japanese bonds over five months, with signs of capital repatriation heating up. IEA monthly report: tight diesel supply will persist until 2027, and OECD oil inventories fell to the lowest since 1989.
